params.prompt:
Create a polished 5-second square social media ad video from this exact cleaning business ad creative. Preserve the original image composition, brand colors, logo, phone screen, booking/reminder UI cards, and ALL existing text exactly as shown. Text must stay perfectly readable for the full video. Do not rewrite, replace, morph, add, or hallucinate any letters, words, numbers, symbols, buttons, logos, UI, hands, cleaning tools, rooms, or people. Keep the headline, subtext, and CTA locked in place with no distortion.

Motion: subtle premium ad motion only — gentle camera push-in, slight parallax between cleaner/background/UI cards, soft light sweep, tiny floating motion on UI cards. Keep text panels stable and sharp. No cuts. No audio. Clean commercial social ad.
